1.web: Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel.
1.asv: Hear ye this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel.

2.web: “The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her up.”
2.asv: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is cast down upon her land; there is none to raise her up.

3.web: For thus says the Lord Yahweh: “The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel.”
3.asv: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: The city that went forth a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went forth a hundred shall have ten left, to the house of Israel.

4.web: For thus says Yahweh to the house of Israel: “Seek me, and you will live;
4.asv: For thus saith Jehovah unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live;

5.web: but don’t seek Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and don’t pass to Beersheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nothing.
5.asv: but seek not Beth-el, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beer-sheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Beth-el shall come to nought.

6.web: Seek Yahweh, and you will live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be no one to quench it in Bethel.
6.asv: Seek Jehovah, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be none to quench it in Beth-el.

7.web: You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth:
7.asv: Ye who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth,

8.web: seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night; who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth, Yahweh is his name,
8.asv: seek him that maketh the Pleiades and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night; that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth (Jehovah is his name);

9.web: who brings sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the fortress.
9.asv: that bringeth sudden destruction upon the strong, so that destruction cometh upon the fortress.

10.web: They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.
10.asv: They hate him that reproveth in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.

11.web: Therefore, because you trample on the poor, and take taxes from him of wheat: You have built houses of cut stone, but you will not dwell in them. You have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine.
11.asv: Forasmuch therefore as ye trample upon the poor, and take exactions from him of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink the wine thereof.

12.web: For I know how many your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who turn aside the needy in the courts.
12.asv: For I know how manifold are your transgressions, and how mighty are your sins—ye that afflict the just, that take a bribe, and that turn aside the needy in the gate from their right.

13.web: Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.
13.asv: Therefore he that is prudent shall keep silence in such a time; for it is an evil time.

14.web: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.
14.asv: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live; and so Jehovah, the God of hosts, will be with you, as ye say.

15.web: Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”
15.asv: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish justice in the gate: it may be that Jehovah, the God of hosts, will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.

16.web: Therefore thus says Yahweh, the God of Armies, the Lord: “Wailing will be in all the broad ways; and they will say in all the streets, ‘Alas! Alas!’ and they will call the farmer to mourning, and those who are skillful in lamentation to wailing.
16.asv: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, the God of hosts, the Lord: Wailing shall be in all the broad ways; and they shall say in all the streets, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful in lamentation to wailing.

17.web: In all vineyards there will be wailing; for I will pass through your midst,” says Yahweh.
17.asv: And in all vineyards shall be wailing; for I will pass through the midst of thee, saith Jehovah.

18.web: “Woe to you who desire the day of Yahweh! Why do you long for the day of Yahweh? It is darkness, and not light.
18.asv: Woe unto you that desire the day of Jehovah! Wherefore would ye have the day of Jehovah? It is darkness, and not light.

19.web: As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; Or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him.
19.asv: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.

20.web: Won’t the day of Yahweh be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?
20.asv: Shall not the day of Jehovah be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?

21.web: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.
21.asv: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I will take no delight in your solemn assemblies.

22.web: Yes, though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.
22.asv: Yea, though ye offer me your burnt-offerings and meal-offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace-offerings of your fat beasts.

23.web: Take away from me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.
23.asv: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.

24.web: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.
24.asv: But let justice roll down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

25.web: “Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?
25.asv: Did ye bring unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?

26.web: You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.
26.asv: Yea, ye have borne the tabernacle of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.

27.web: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus,” says Yahweh, whose name is the God of Armies.
27.asv: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith Jehovah, whose name is the God of hosts.
